d:
From Hollywood icons and comedy stars to legendary villains and magical performers, Josh Gates has some unforgettable conversations lined up! Christopher Lloyd looks back at time travel, Dominic Monaghan and Billy Boyd bring some magic to the table, while Kevin Bacon, Gabriel Iglesias and Giancarlo Esposito share stories from their worlds. Catch the best celebrity moments as Josh gets his guests talking.
Watch Josh Gates Tonight, S3, Episodes 4, 6, 3, 2, 1 & 5 on Discovery Channel India.
